snippet.title: Hooked - Ludum Dare 59
snippet.description:
Ludum Dare again! I was making music and doing the sound design for this game

You can play here:
https://echerryart.itch.io/ld59hooked

Or can you rate if you are also a member of the jam:
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/59/hooked-a27o1
